title: Commercial guardrails
content:
Commercial guardrails

Keep at least 35% contribution after direct delivery costs and expected payment fees. Do not put more than ₹10,000 of Pinecone cash at risk before collection. The smallest instalment is ₹10,000 before GST and payment plans may run for at most 12 months. Expected payment fees are 2%. No discount is approved in the default policy.
